directive.quote: Inspect actual current head, CI and source; fix root causes without weakening checks or inventing provenance.

preserve: The shared reference-contract validator and its source identities, redactions and ownership checks
The repository judge over staged and committed feature-file DATA
The Git reader for source snapshots, current targets and old-copy retirement
allowed_deltas: Verify immutable regular-file baseline bytes, target chronology and rename records against the judged commit
Use the complete feature-file scope for active-only retention; refuse ambiguous archival targets
Ignore Git replacement objects and refuse incomplete shallow or grafted chronology
Share one immutable raw Git DAG/history index and bounded metadata, blob and published-search caches per reader; copy public results
Validate one loaded complete contract once per immutable judge scope while retaining exact claimed-feature ownership
Read same-repository source retirement from the judged candidate or staged index, keeping unreadable state distinct and external published main authoritative
Bind reader and judge Git operations to their declared repository, freeze committed diff endpoints, and preserve the caller's private staged index while refusing generation changes during a judgment
banned_substitutions: A rewritten validator or application-specific bypass
An archival snapshot as active retention or retrospective source-first history
Weaker source identities, privacy controls or retention thresholds
